title: Silky Uruguayan Stir Fry
description: A unique blend of Uruguayan flavors in a traditional Chinese stir fry. Pungent and silky ingredients come together to create a memorable dish.

ingredients.name: uruguayan cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a mild Uruguayan cheese like Oveja Negra

ingredients.name: pungent leek
ingredients.notes: Make sure to caramelize the leeks for added depth

ingredients.name: silky soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality soy sauce for the best flavor

ingredients.name: gratin potatoes
ingredients.notes: Use leftover gratin potatoes for added convenience

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil like canola or grapeseed

instructions: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced leeks and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the grated Uruguayan cheese and cook until melted and bubbly.
4. Add the sliced gratin potatoes and stir to combine with the cheese and leeks.
5. Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes are coated in the sauce.
